data.long_meaning: Aadil (عادل) is the Arabic ʿādil, 'just, fair, honest, equitable', the active participle of ʿadala, 'to act justly'. It is one of the most widely used Muslim male names, from the root ʿ-d-l, the root of ʿadl (justice).

faq.q: What does the name Aadil mean?
faq.a: Aadil means Just; fair; honest; equitable (ʿādil).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aadil?
What language does the name Aadil come from?
faq.a: Aadil is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aadil a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadil is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aadil written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aadil is written عادل in Arabic and عادل in Urdu, and आदिल in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aadil?
faq.a: The root of Aadil is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aadil?
faq.a: Arabic ʿādil, active participle of ʿadala, 'to act justly'.

faq.q: Does Aadil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿādil is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-d-l.
Aadil is the Arabic ʿādil, meaning 'just, fair, honest, equitable'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aadil?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadil total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aadil?
faq.a: Aadil appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Adil, Aadhil.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aadil?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aadil include Aadila, Aadilah.

faq.q: Is Aadil related to the word ʿadl?
faq.a: Yes. Both come from the root ʿ-d-l: ʿadl means 'justice', and ʿādil is 'one who is just'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aadil used today?
faq.a: Aadil is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
